caption: The drawing features a single black button-up ankle boot positioned in profile, facing left, occupying most of the lower right side of the composition. The boot has a pointed toe, a moderately low heel with a brown undersole visible at the back, and a series of buttons running along the outer side from the toe to the top of the ankle. The shoe features subtle gray outlines and shading to suggest depth and stitching details. To the left of the main boot, there are two lightly sketched, uncolored outlines of the shoe shown from the top view and the side, detailing the button placements and overall contours. The background is an off-white, slightly textured paper, with no additional items or patterns present. The artist's signature "M. Concha." appears in the lower right corner.
title: Woman's Shoe
